# Qwen3 14B

Alibaba · released 2025-04 · 14.8B params · apache-2.0

**score 42.3** ±2.1

#143 of 205 · from 10 benchmark results across 8 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Alibaba) · $0.61/M blended · $0.35 in / $1.4 out per 1M tokens · [www.alibabacloud.com ↗](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/models)

[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/alibaba/models/qwen3-14b.toml) · Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ.

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-14B/blob/40c069824f4251a91eefaf281ebe4c544efd3e18/README.md) · Native/default model-card context. Any YaRN extension must be configured separately; hosted provider limits may differ.

| local download | size | score | command |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 4-bit q4\_k\_m | ~9.38GB | 42.3 | `ollama run qwen3:14b` |
| 8-bit q8\_0 | ~18.26GB | 42.3 | `ollama run qwen3:14b-q8_0` |

The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.
